messages:
Priya (CSM): heads up — Solstice Retail renewal in ~6 weeks. saw a 68% drop in API calls last 30d vs prior period :warning:. procurement changed sponsors; new lead is talking to ApexAI per their vendor brief. filing this as renewal risk, need quick triage.
Sam (AE): yikes. can you drop the dashboard link and a short list of what's stopped? i'll reach out to the exec sponsor. :eyes:
Priya (CSM): dashboard: https://redwood.app/boards/solstice/usage (internal)
Priya (CSM): quick snapshot:
```
last_30d_calls: 12,400
prev_30d_calls: 38,800
active_users: 42 -> 19
top-api: chat.generate -> down 72%
```
Priya (CSM): they also paused the recommendations pilot last week after a procurement cost review.
Alyssa (CS Ops): pulled logs and billing trend — looks correlated with a reduction in peak-hour traffic and two disabled integrations (search-sync + realtime-ingest). probable cause: they toggled off ingest to cut cost after cost spike in Jan.
Alyssa (CS Ops): query I ran: `SELECT date, calls FROM usage WHERE customer='solstice' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 60;`
Jorge (Product): any feature gaps reported? did ApexAI offer something functionally different (e.g., cheaper embeddings or hosted index)?
Priya (CSM): Solstice cited "cheaper per-embed price" in their brief and a +1 from their Head of Procurement who prefers single-vendor consolidation. no major feature asks; it's more commercial and latency/cost story.
Sam (AE): plan proposal: 1) immediate outreach to exec sponsor, 2) propose 3-month pilot on Dedicated with a tailored quantized model + caching to show unit-cost drop, 3) offer an enablement session for their eng leads to re-enable integrations safely. asking @Alyssa for cost delta numbers we can promise.
Alyssa (CS Ops): I can run a quick delta for Dedicated+KV-caching vs hosted at their current volume. estimate back in ~2 hours. also prepping a short one-pager on batching + quantization impact for the AE deck.
Priya (CSM): i'll schedule a stakeholder call and include their procurement and engineering lead. can someone draft the one-pager and a fallback concession (e.g., 10% short-term credit) if needed?
Sam (AE): i'll draft the concession bullets. Jorge, can product confirm any constraints for quantized model release to a customer pilot?
Jorge (Product): quantized variant exists but we need to confirm model size and latency expectations for Solstice's query distribution. i'll run perf sims and confirm within EOD.
Priya (CSM): thanks. tagging this as P1 risk for renewal. i'll share meeting invite when calendar-bot confirms. :calendar:
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled — Solstice renewal triage, Thu 10am PT — invites sent to Solstice procurement, eng, and Redwood core team.
Priya (CSM): next steps checklist:
- Sam: exec outreach + concession draft
- Alyssa: cost delta + one-pager
- Jorge: perf sim for quantized variant
- Priya: schedule + capture stakeholder mapping
Will update thread after the 10am call. Keep reactions / short notes here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
